award.reason: Caleb Douglas scored 20.0 on a 6.25 projection, 13.75 over, in a 14.47-point win after a recent roster move.

matchups.recap: Lil Fridge left Caleb Williams and his 22.12 on the bench to start Bryce Young's 7.42, a swap that would have flipped the result. Return of T Mac pulled the upset anyway, getting 14.7 from recent add Bijan Robinson while the other side's new pickup, Courtland Sutton, managed 6. To top it off, the league leaders now have Christian McCaffrey listed Questionable.

Brock ‘N’ Roll beat Maye d'force B with U 85.87 to 81.19 in an upset, a race to the bottom where both sides posted a season low. Recent adds Chris Godwin Jr. and Tyler Allgeier managed 4.7 and 6.4, and the Jets defense, another new pickup, finished below zero. On the other side, Jaylen Waddle is now listed Questionable, and new pickup Zonovan Knight edged past his projection.

CeeDee Lamb showed up for behold the lamb, and they still lost 106.12 to 91.65 to Unsolicited Dak Picks in an upset. Caleb Douglas, a recent add, outscored the margin on his own with 20, and fellow recent add Josh Jacobs did the same with 17.6. Saquon Barkley is now listed Questionable, and the losing side's own new pickups, Kyler Murray and the Cleveland Browns defense, both landed under projection.

Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team ran London Cooking out of its own kitchen in an upset. Tony Pollard, a recent add by trade, posted 35, while the other side's trade for Nico Collins returned 1.6. Garrett Wilson, another trade add for the winners, managed just 3.6, and Woody Marks, Drake London and Amon-Ra St. Brown are now listed Questionable.

All You Need Is Love took down Bo Girds in an upset, and Joe Burrow outscored the margin on his own with 28.88. The new pickup Devaughn Vele chipped in 13.9 for the losing side, and they have now lost 3 straight. Aaron Jones Sr. is now listed Questionable, and the winners posted a season high with next to nothing from him.

Pukancun on 3 hung a season high on To Infinity and Bijan, winning 122.5 to 106.32 in an upset. The new pickups on the losing side went nowhere: the Titans defense finished at -0.7 and Jaylin Noel, now listed Questionable, managed 0.7. Cam Skattebo, a recent add for the winners who is now listed Questionable, outscored the margin on his own.

blurbs.motw: Return of T Mac knocked off first-place Lil Fridge 101.61 to 89.77 in an upset. The answer was on the bench: Caleb Williams sat on 22.12 while Bryce Young finished dead last among started QBs, and that swap flips the result. Bold lineup call. Bijan Robinson, the recent trade add, managed just 14.7 and still outscored the margin on his own. On the losing side, the new pickup Courtland Sutton posted 6. Christian McCaffrey put up 19 for the leaders and is now listed Questionable.
blurbs.game_changer: Caleb Douglas, the new pickup, turned a 6.25 projection into 20 points and the Game Changer. Unsolicited Dak Picks took down behold the lamb in an upset, and did it with the Ravens defense finishing at -4. Douglas outscored the margin on his own, and Josh Jacobs, a trade acquisition, chipped in 17.6. On the other side, the new pickups Kyler Murray and the Browns defense both came in under projection. Saquon Barkley, who put up 14.1 for the losing side, is now listed Questionable on Sleeper.

Jaxon Smith-Njigba led the receivers at 26.8 for Lil Fridge, on the biggest share of his team's targets and air yards among started WRs.
